# Nova Split

> Nova Split is an AI SEO Generator. Starting from a product brief, it
> performs deep research, creates target-audience persona profiles, and
> produces SEO article directions tailored to a selected platform, audience,
> and business goal.

## Language routes

- Traditional Chinese (default): /zh/
- English: /en/

## Discovery

- /sitemap.xml — full list of all pages
- /robots.txt — crawl policy
